title: ID0426793-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S5 170003620] Face Issues with the Charger
description:
R&
Reported behaviour/issue:  We again Face Issues with the Charger in Deutsch Wagram. 1. When you take a look at the screenshot attached, you can see that we have two Charging sessions with the same ID at the same time. This happend several times. How is this possible?? Because of this, the load management controller (OCPP) sets the Power Limit down! and customers are not satisfied. 2. Duplicate start transactions, 2 different IDs: o 2025-05-23 12:26 3. Sample.Periodic MeterValue Befehl comes often per second
5/27/2025: L2 → L3
Unable to create child case due to ISP bug
R&D ticket: EVC3-9556

additional_info.subject: From RC
additional_info.body:
We again Face Issues with the Charger in Deutsch Wagram.
1. When you take a look at the screenshot attached, you can see
that we have two Charging sessions with the same ID at the same
time. This happend several times.
How is this possible??
Because of this, the load management controller (OCPP) sets the
Power Limit down! and customers are not satisfied.
2. Duplicate start transactions, 2 different IDs:
o 2025-05-23 12:26
3. Sample.Periodic MeterValue Befehl comes often per second
-->EXAMPLE: 2025-05-23 12:27:35 9 x all 15 seconds 4. When restarting the LMS, old past StopTransactions IDs come

additional_info.subject: L2 --> L3
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause :
NA
Problem Description :
Two Charging sessions with the same ID at the same time, because of this, the load management controller (OCPP) sets the Power Limit down. Duplicate start transactions, 2 different IDs.
Action Performed (L2) :
Log analysis. Found that, for a single charging session, 3 different Transaction IDs are created but MeterValues are assigned to only 1 TransactionID from those 3.
Charger SW Version:
V7.0.5
Reason for Handover (L3) :
Need to check if there is any bug
Fault history : NA
Log analysis with timestamp :
Mentioned in timeline
Action Required
Action by HQ : Further analysis
Attachement
: refer attched logs
